description: This source file defines the 'CassandraClusteringTable' class which implements the 'IMembershipTable' interface for managing cluster membership data in Cassandra. It includes methods for initialization, inserting, updating, reading, and cleaning up membership entries, along with internal logic for session management and data parsing.

classes.name: CassandraClusteringTable
classes.description: Implements the IMembershipTable interface for managing cluster membership state using Cassandra as storage.

methods.name: CassandraClusteringTable
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies and configuration options for the CassandraClusteringTable.

methods.name: InitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Initializes the membership table by creating a new session and ensuring the required Cassandra table exists.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes all entries in the membership table for a specific cluster ID.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Inserts a new membership entry row if it does not already exist or if the version is newer.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Updates an existing membership row with new data.

methods.name: GetMembershipEntry
methods.description: Parses a database row into a MembershipEntry object, including suspecting silos.

methods.name: GetMembershipTableData
methods.description: Converts a set of database rows into MembershipTableData.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Reads all membership entries from Cassandra.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a specific row identified by SiloAddress.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the IAmAlive timestamp for a given membership entry.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes silos that are not active and haven't been alive or started since a given date.
